headline: The oriented-Pauli LABEL permutation CZ*(-I) admits an exact 240-root E8 lift through the Coxeter fibration, preserving the full Gram matrix and yielding C6 x C3. This is not a physical lift of flagship theta^3 parity: physical parity is inner on su9 with fixed dimension 40, whereas the Coxeter half-turn is outer with fixed dimension 36.

physical_parity_firewall.coxeter_half_turn_d3: outer on su9; fixed so9; dimension 36
physical_parity_firewall.conclusion: 40 != 36; label antipode is not physical parity

next_target: Construct or rule out an E8/Chevalley realization of the inner 5+4 parity together with the commuting 5+2+2 order-three holonomy.
